samples.question: The grey stroke in this picture is one single wire. It never branches and never crosses or touches itself, so it has exactly two loose ends and you can follow it from one end to the other. One red dot, one green dot and one blue dot sit on this wire. The halfway point of the wire is the point on the wire that has the same length of wire to one loose end as to the other. Measure every distance only as length along the wire, following each of its turns; straight-line distance across the picture does not count, and neither does the middle of the page. Which dot is nearest to the halfway point of the wire, measured along the wire? Answer red, green or blue.
